# Grove Collaborative

> > Grove Collaborative is an eco-friendly marketplace offering vetted household essentials, cleaning products, and supplements with transparent ingredient standards and measurable environmental impact.

Grove Collaborative combines sustainable e-commerce with environmental accountability through initiatives like Beyond Plastic™ and plastic impact tracking. The company prioritizes ingredient transparency, B Corp certification, and partnerships with ethical brands to help customers make healthier home choices.

## Company & Mission

- [Eco-Friendly Home Essentials & Healthier Living](https://www.grove.co): Grove Collaborative homepage: eco-friendly essentials, cleaning, and supplements.
- [Our Mission](https://www.grove.co/pages/our-mission): Grove's mission statement and company values around sustainability.
- [A Higher Standard](https://www.grove.co/pages/higher-standard): B Corp certification, product vetting, and ingredient safety standards.
- [Environmental Impact](https://www.grove.co/pages/environmental-impact): Grove's environmental commitments: carbon-neutral, plastic-neutral, forest conservation.

## Environmental Initiatives & Impact

- [Beyond Plastic](https://www.grove.co/pages/beyond-plastic): Beyond Plastic™ initiative tracking plastic reduction and ocean conservation.
- [Plastic Impact Tracker](https://www.grove.co/pages/impact-tracker): Plastic Impact Tracker showing customer environmental impact metrics.

## Products & Collections

- [Cleaning Essentials](https://www.grove.co/collections/cleaning-essentials): Vetted cleaning products collection with safer ingredients.

- [The Unplastic Shop](https://www.grove.co/pages/unplastic-shop): Curated plastic-free product collection from The Plastic Detox producers.
